episode_summary: This episode explores the ongoing dispute between Compass, Zillow, and MLSs over listing data control, highlighting the implications for agents. Ben Lalez shares innovative solutions like AI-driven cancellation insurance and content creation strategies to enhance real estate operations and marketing. The discussion emphasizes the need for agent advocacy and leveraging technology to stay competitive.
